$comment: Generated from rights.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to rights.yaml>`. Do not edit.
description: What the researcher has said about the dataset that bears on its licence and access: the reuse they want to allow, whether the data are sensitive, any licence they are required to use, and whether the data include content from third parties.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

reuse_wanted.description: The reuse the researcher wants to allow, e.g. any, attribution, share-alike or non-commercial. Unknown if absent.

sensitive.description: Whether the data hold personal or otherwise sensitive information. Unknown if absent.

mandated_licence.description: The SPDX identifier of a licence that a funder, journal or institution requires, if any.

third_party_content.description: Whether the data include content whose rights belong to others. Unknown if absent.

title: RightsContext
